findings.issue: אֵין is a negative existential (there is not) with דָּבָר (a thing). "sin cosa" swaps in the preposition without and drops the existential.
מִקְנַי is masculine plural. "ganado" is a singular collective; the herd is the same referent, but the grammatical number is not.
Qal cohortative (volitive) is rendered as future indicative "pasaré"; the qal stem remains, the let-me force does not.
בְּ on the dual feet is rendered "con" (with/by means of); the preposition also allows locative on/in.

notes: The speech, Israel, the highway ascent, the conditional drinking, and giving their price match the tokens.
